div.div: سَحَّارَةٌ (tropical:) A certain plaything of children; (A, K, TA;) having a string attached to it; (A;) which, when extended in one direction, turns out to be of one colour; and when extended in another direction, turns out to be of another colour: (A, * TA:) it is also called ↓ سَحْرٌ : and whatever. resembles it is called by the former appellation: so says Lth. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
